summary: Root cause found and documented (D266): React Fizz has no server-side error boundaries, so any notFound() thrown while rendering a page aborts the HTML shell and Next 16 falls back to its error shell (<html id="__next_error__"> with an empty body, next/dist/server/app-render/app-render.js getErrorRSCPayload); the not-found UI is then client-rendered from the RSC payload. Only URLs matching no route are server-rendered via /_not-found. This is framework behaviour, not a Suspense/loading boundary in this app, and cannot be changed from page code or the proxy without a per-request existence lookup. Fixed in this package: 404 title (both not-found files export privateMetadata('Stranica nije pronađena') -> server HTML title 'Stranica nije pronađena | SKLOP' on every dynamic 404 instead of the home title), and the error shell now bootstraps the much lighter /_not-found entry so the client paint comes sooner. Unknown URLs keep a fully server-rendered 404 (h1, GET search form, categories) with status 404. Open part: an h1 in the server HTML of thrown 404s on /deo, /delovi, /vozila, /porudzbina, /upit is not achievable with Next 16's notFound() contract.
verification: curl http://localhost:3001/deo/ne-postoji-demo-9999 -> 404, '<title>Stranica nije pronađena | SKLOP</title>' + 'noindex' (before: 'SKLOP — Rasklopi auto. Nađi deo.'); same for /delovi/ne-postoji-kategorija; body still the Next error shell with data-next-error-message="NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404". Experiment: a (shop)/[...nepostojece] catch-all calling notFound() turned /ovo-ne-postoji-2 into the same empty error shell (404, no h1), proving the cause is the thrown notFound itself. curl /ovo-ne-postoji -> 404, h1 'Stranica nije pronađena', role="search", title 'Stranica nije pronađena | SKLOP'. Browser after hydration: verify.json notFound -> /deo/ne-postoji-demo-9999 title 'Stranica nije pronađena | SKLOP', h1 'Stranica nije pronađena' at 390 and 1440.
